name: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to Scheduled Tribe category
description: Vocational Training Fee reimbursement for the students belonging to Scheduled Tribe Category Students and admitted to the seats under PPP scheme in Government ITIs and Private ITIs through Centralized Admission Process. They will avail Fee Reimbursement benefit only if they met the Scheme Criteria.

evidence.quote: 1. Student should belong to ST Category and also provide Caste Validity Certificate.

criteria.label: 2. Original Leaving Certificate / Transfer Certificate is Mandatory.

evidence.quote: 2. Original Leaving Certificate / Transfer Certificate is Mandatory.

criteria.label: 3. Scheme applicable for SSC Pass and SSC Fail.

evidence.quote: 3. Scheme applicable for SSC Pass and SSC Fail.

criteria.label: 4. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

evidence.quote: 4. Admission taken through PPP scheme in Government Skill Development Institute or Private Institute and admitted through central Online Admission Process.

criteria.label: 5. No Fee reimbursement for Management Quota Admission.

evidence.quote: 5. No Fee reimbursement for Management Quota Admission.

criteria.label: 6. Overall Family Income will be considered (Father + Mother Income)

evidence.quote: 6. Overall Family Income will be considered (Father + Mother Income)

criteria.label: 7. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

evidence.quote: 7. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for course previously from Government or Private ITI.

criteria.label: 8. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.

evidence.quote: 8. Candidate should not have taken any benefit for training program sponsored by State / Central Government / Department / Local Body / Company or Corporation.
9. Domicile of Maharashtra

criteria.label: 10. Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses

evidence.quote: 10. Admission taken for DGT, New Delhi or MSCVT approved courses
11. Benefit applicable to only 2 children.
12. Attendance criteria is mandatory.

criteria.label: 13. Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If not after recommendation by Student and Institute, Project Officer integrated Tribal Development Project should certify or recommend.

evidence.quote: 13. Candidate need to attend each semester /annual exam. If not after recommendation by Student and Institute, Project Officer integrated Tribal Development Project should certify or recommend.

criteria.label: 14. Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for reimbursement.

evidence.quote: 14. Non Satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct- Failure in academic year, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible for reimbursement.
1. Student should belong to ST Category and also provide Caste Validity Certificate.

benefits.text:
1. SSC Pass and Family income Less than or equal to 2,50,000 then As Per GOI scholarship.
2. SSC Pass and Family income above 2,50,000 to Less than or up to 8,00,000 Lakh then 100 % reimbursement of Course Fee.
3. SSc Fail and Family income up to 8,00,000 Lakh then 100 % reimbursement of Course Fee.

evidence.quote: 1. SSC Pass and Family income Less than or equal to 2,50,000 then As Per GOI scholarship.
Required Documents As per GR
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Ration Card
3. Mark sheet SSC / HSC

documents.name: 4. Previous year mark sheet for renewal

evidence.quote: 4. Previous year mark sheet for renewal
5. Domicile certificate
6. Income certificate by competent authority

documents.name: 7. Caste certificate and Caste validity certificate

evidence.quote: 7. Caste certificate and Caste validity certificate

renewal:
i) The student have to be on roll in next year.
ii) Attendance is As per DGT criteria.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
